'''Iosif Ilyich Gikhman''' ({{langx|uk|Йосип Ілліч Гіхман}}; May 26, 1918{{spaced ndash}}July 30, 1985)<ref>{{cite web| url = http://probability.univ.kiev.ua/msta4/thesises/Conf_materials_MSTA4.pdf | work= [[Kiev State University]] Conference Materials |date= May 24–26, 2018| title = Modern Stochastics: Theory and Application. IV. Dedicated to the 100-th anniversary of I. I. Gikhman|accessdate = March 5, 2021}}</ref> was a Soviet mathematician. 

Gikhman is well known for a comprehensive treatise on the theory of [[stochastic processes]], co-authored with [[Anatoliy Skorokhod|Skorokhod]].<ref name="GikhmanSkorokhod2004_I"></ref><ref name="GikhmanSkorokhod2004_II"></ref><ref name="GikhmanSkorokhod2007_III"></ref>
In the words of mathematician and probability theorist [[Daniel W. Stroock]]<ref>{{cite journal|author=Stroock, Daniel W.|authorlink=Daniel W. Stroock|title=Review: ''The theory of stochastic processes'', by I. I. Gihman and A. V. Skorokhod|journal=Bull. Amer. Math. Soc. (N.S.)|year=1980|volume=2|issue=2|pages=388–390|url=https://www.ams.org/journals/bull/1980-02-02/S0273-0979-1980-14773-4/S0273-0979-1980-14773-4.pdf|doi=10.1090/s0273-0979-1980-14773-4|doi-access=free}}</ref> "Gikhman and Skorokhod have done an excellent job of presenting the theory in its present state of rich imperfection.”

==Career==
Gikhman graduated in 1939 from the Physics and Mathematics Faculty of [[Taras Shevchenko National University of Kyiv|Kiev University]] and began his scientific career in postgraduate studies under the supervision of [[Nikolay Bogolyubov|N.N. Bogolyubov]].

After the war, Gikhman worked first at the Kiev Automobile and Highway Institute, and from 1948 to 1966 he worked at the [[Kiev State University]] first as an assistant professor, then later as professor, and later as head of the Department of Probability Theory. In 1955, he defended his doctoral dissertation "Markov processes and some problems of mathematical statistics", and in 1959, he received the title of professor.

In 1965, Gikhman was elected a Corresponding Member of the [[National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine]]. Since 1966, he had been in charge of the Department of Probability Theory of the Institute of Applied Mathematics and Mechanics of the [[National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine]] in Donetsk, and directed the scientific work of the Department of Probability Theory at [[Donetsk State University]].

His scientific works are devoted mainly to various problems of mathematical statistics and the theory of random processes. He co-authored with [[Anatoliy Skorokhod|A.V. Skorokhod]] several books that were translated into English, and played an important role in the development of modern probability theory and the theory of stochastic processes.<ref name="Portenko2008">{{cite journal|last1=Portenko|first1=M. I.|title=Beginning of the Ukrainian School of Probability Theory: A historical sketch|journal= Theory of Probability and Mathematical Statistics|volume=79|year=2009|pages=1–5|doi=10.1090/S0094-9000-09-00786-8|url=https://www.ams.org/journals/tpms/2009-79-00/S0094-9000-09-00786-8/S0094-9000-09-00786-8.pdf|doi-access=free}}</ref><ref name="SkorokhodYadrenko1995">{{cite journal|last1=Skorokhod|first1=A. V.|last2=Yadrenko|first2=M. I.|title=I. I. Gikhman: A brief review of scientific and pedagogic activity|journal=Theory of Probability and Mathematical Statistics |volume=50|year=1995|pages=1–6}}</ref><ref name="Daniluk1968">{{cite journal|last1=Danilyuk|first1=I. I.|last2=Korolyuk|first2=V. S.|last3=Mitropolskij|first3=Yu. A.|last4=Skorokhod|first4=A. V.|last5=Yadrenko|first5=M. I.|title=Fiftieth birthday of Iosif Illich Gikhman|journal= Ukr. Math. J.|volume=20|year=1968|issue=3|pages= 316–319|doi=10.1007/BF01085946|s2cid=121036519}}</ref><ref name="LinkovYadrenko1998">{{cite journal|last1= Linkov|first1=Yurii N.|last2=Yadrenko|first2=Mikhail I.|title=To the 80th birthday of Iosif I. Gikhman|journal=Theory Stoch. Process.|volume=20|issue=4|year=1998|pages=1–16}}</ref>
